D&D 5E - Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide..rationale: Agent reviewed every printed player option: subraces and mutually exclusive variants, the deep-gnome feat, Spiked Armor, all eleven subclasses, the six additional totem options, four cantrips, the Investigator variant, and all twelve named backgrounds. Setting lore remains searchable source context.

inventory_template.name: Spiked Armor
inventory_template.description: Medium armor used by Battleragers; 75 gp and 45 lb.

card.name: Battlerager Armor
card.description: Use spiked armor for the printed rage bonus attack and grapple damage.

card.name: Reckless Abandon
card.description: Reckless Attack while raging grants Constitution-modifier temporary hit points.

card.name: Battlerager Charge
card.description: Dash as a bonus action while raging.

card.name: Spiked Retribution
card.description: A nearby attacker takes the printed piercing damage while you rage in spiked armor.

card.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
card.description: Turn one celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend using the printed Channel Divinity save.

card.name: Arcane Banishment
card.description: Upgrades Arcane Abjuration to banish qualifying creatures by CR.

card.name: Spell Breaker
card.description: Healing a creature with a spell can end a qualifying spell on it.

card.name: Potent Spellcasting
card.description: Add Wisdom modifier to cleric cantrip damage.

card.name: Rallying Cry
card.description: Second Wind also heals up to three visible or audible allies by fighter level.

card.name: Inspiring Surge
card.description: Action Surge lets an ally use its reaction for one weapon attack; two allies at level 18.

card.name: Bulwark
card.description: Indomitable can extend its reroll to one failing ally on the same effect.

card.name: Touch of Death
card.description: Reducing a nearby creature to 0 HP grants Wisdom plus monk-level temporary HP.

card.name: Hour of Reaping
card.description: Action frightens nearby creatures that can see you on a Wisdom save.

card.name: Mastery of Death
card.description: Spend 1 ki to remain at 1 HP instead of falling to 0 HP.

card.name: Touch of the Long Death
card.description: Spend 1-10 ki after touching a creature for the printed necrotic damage save.

card.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
card.description: Ranged radiant spell attack uses Dexterity and Martial Arts die; supports Flurry bolts.

card.name: Searing Arc Strike
card.description: After Attack, spend ki to cast and upcast Burning Hands as a bonus action.

card.name: Searing Sunburst
card.description: Action creates a ranged radiant burst; spend up to 3 ki to add damage dice.

card.name: Sun Shield
card.description: Emit or suppress light; reaction deals Wisdom-modifier radiant damage to a melee attacker.

card.name: Channel Divinity
card.description: Champion Challenge and Turn the Tide use the paladin's Channel Divinity.

card.name: Divine Allegiance
card.description: Reaction takes damage for a creature within 5 feet without transferring other effects.

card.name: Unyielding Spirit
card.description: Advantage on saves against paralysis and stun.

card.name: Exalted Champion
card.description: One-hour transformation grants the printed resistances, ally save advantage, and death-save benefit once per long rest.

card.name: Master of Tactics
card.description: Help as a bonus action, including aiding an attack within 30 feet of the target.

card.name: Insightful Manipulator
card.description: One minute of interaction reveals the source-defined comparative capabilities.

card.name: Misdirection
card.description: Redirect a cover-providing attack to the creature granting cover.

card.name: Soul of Deceit
card.description: Thought reading and truth magic receive the exact source false result.

card.name: Fancy Footwork
card.description: A creature you melee attack cannot opportunity attack you that turn.

card.name: Rakish Audacity
card.description: Add Charisma to initiative and gain the printed isolated-duel Sneak Attack route.

card.name: Panache
card.description: Persuasion contested by Insight produces the source combat or noncombat effect.

card.name: Elegant Maneuver
card.description: Bonus action grants advantage on the next Acrobatics or Athletics check that turn.

card.name: Master Duelist
card.description: Reroll a missed attack with advantage once per short or long rest.

card.name: Wind Speaker
card.description: Speak, read, and write Primordial and its four elemental dialects.

card.name: Tempestuous Magic
card.description: Bonus action before or after a 1st-level-or-higher spell flies 10 feet without opportunity attacks.

card.name: Heart of the Storm
card.description: Lightning/thunder resistance and source-level splash damage when casting such spells.

card.name: Storm Guide
card.description: Use an action to stop rain or a bonus action to redirect wind in the source area.

card.name: Storm's Fury
card.description: Reaction damages and may push a melee attacker on a failed Strength save.

card.name: Wind Soul
card.description: Lightning/thunder immunity, flight, and the source one-hour party flight grant.

card.name: Among the Dead
card.description: Learn Spare the Dying and gain the source disease and undead-targeting defenses.

card.name: Defy Death
card.description: Regain source hit points after a death save success or Spare the Dying once per long rest.

card.name: Undying Nature
card.description: Source breathing, sustenance, aging, sleep, and magical-aging protections.

card.name: Indestructible Life
card.description: Bonus action regains source hit points and can reattach a severed part once per rest.

card.name: Bladesong
card.description: Bonus action starts the one-minute source AC, speed, Acrobatics, and concentration benefits.

card.name: Extra Attack
card.description: Attack twice when taking the Attack action.

card.name: Song of Defense
card.description: Reaction spends a spell slot to reduce damage by five times the slot level.

card.name: Song of Victory
card.description: Add Intelligence modifier to melee weapon damage while Bladesong is active.

card.name: Arcane Initiate
card.description: Gain Arcana proficiency, or expertise when already proficient, and two Wizard cantrips treated as cleric cantrips.

card.name: Arcane Mastery
card.description: Choose one Wizard spell of each level 6 through 9; each becomes a domain spell and is always prepared.

card.name: Royal Envoy
card.description: Gain Persuasion proficiency, or double proficiency when already proficient.

card.name: Master of Intrigue
card.description: Gain Disguise Kit and Forgery Kit plus two languages and one gaming set; mimicry remains source context.

card.name: Training in War and Song
card.description: Gain light armor and one one-handed melee weapon proficiency.

card.name: Totem Spirit
card.description: Choose exactly one of the source's additional Uthgardt totem options.

card.name: Totem Spirit (Elk)
card.description: While raging, walking speed increases by 15 feet.

card.name: Totem Spirit (Tiger)
card.description: While raging, long jump increases 10 feet and high jump 3 feet.

card.name: Aspect of the Beast
card.description: Choose exactly one of the source's additional Uthgardt totem options.

card.name: Aspect of the Beast (Elk)
card.description: Mounted or foot travel pace doubles for up to ten companions within 60 feet.

card.name: Aspect of the Beast (Tiger)
card.description: Gain proficiency in two of Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth, and Survival.

card.name: Totemic Attunement
card.description: Choose exactly one of the source's additional Uthgardt totem options.

card.name: Totemic Attunement (Elk)
card.description: Bonus action passes through a Large-or-smaller creature and may knock it prone with source damage.

card.name: Totemic Attunement (Tiger)
card.description: While raging, move at least 20 feet then make an extra melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
